result.paraphrase: Seagate BarraCuda Pro 10TB HDD for SATA 6.0Gb/s, 256MB cache. Model ST10000DM0004 in bare-drive packaging. Provides 10TB capacity with a 7200 RPM spindle speed, 6Gb/s interface, and average latency. Highest-capacity option for the 3.5-inch PC class, with up to 12TB available. Built for peace of mind with a 300TB/year workload limit, sustained transfer rates up to 250MB/s, and burst rates of 6Gb/s. One of the lowest-power 3.5-inch drives on the market. Includes Seagate Rescue Data Recovery for 2 years against mechanical, accidental, or natural disaster damage, with a 90% in-house recovery success rate. Backed by over 20 years of Barracuda reliability and optimized for creative applications with improved random performance and drive reliability over typical PC compute drives. Gaming hard drive. 3.5-inch form factor; maximum dimensions are 26.11mm high, 101.85mm wide, and 146.99mm long. First available July 19, 2016.
